intentionalDifferences.reason: Ether emits an ETag for If-Range resume; an additional HTTP validator is valid even when the reference omits it.

notApplicable.reason: The public picker omits login timestamps until the viewer authenticates.
notApplicable.clientAudit: Emby.SDK UserDto.LastLoginDate is not required. Emby Android TV, Emby for iOS, and Emby for Android select a public user by Id and Name; the timestamp is secondary text on the server-hosted web login, which Ether does not ship. Authenticated /Users/Me still returns an observed LastLoginDate.

notApplicable.reason: The public picker omits activity timestamps until the viewer authenticates.
notApplicable.clientAudit: Emby.SDK UserDto.LastActivityDate is not required. The same native clients that use the public user list do not need it to sign in or browse. Authenticated user responses still return an observed LastActivityDate.
